{{Quote|While I don't think I can hold Borleias, I might be able to make it a name that causes little Vong children to whimper.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], during the [[Battle of Borleias (Yuuzhan Vong War; Second)|Second Battle of Borleias]]|<ref name="EL1RD" />}}
'''Borleias''' was the fourth and only inhabited [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Pyria system]]. It was located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], at the edge of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]] and along the [[Namadii Corridor/Legends|Namadii Corridor]].

Every year it went through a meteor shower. A jungle planet with beautiful beaches and seas, it was poor in natural resources.

==History==
===Galactic Republic era===
[[File:AlderaanBioticsFacility-TEGtPaM.png|thumb|left|150px|[[Alderaan Biotics facility]]]]
Borleias was the site of an [[Alderaan Biotics]] operation established about [[700 BBY]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] established a small base on the world, using it as a waypoint for transport to the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].

In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], the ''[[Outbound Flight]]'' expedition traveled through the system on its voyage from [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]] to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="TEA" />

===Galactic Civil War===
Under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Alderaan Biotics facility]] was converted into a black-market production facility by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Evir Derricote]] before he was transferred to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to create the [[Krytos virus]] for [[Ysanne Isard]]. The world was otherwise left largely alone. To prevent a potential [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] incursion to the world (a possible stepping stone to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]), the Empire expanded its military base, including four [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] and two [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]].

[[File:Evir_Derricote_and_scientist.png|thumb|left|130px|General [[Evir Derricote|Derricote]] and Borleian [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]]]]

Giving it the code name "'''Blackmoon'''," the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] finally captured the world after a first [[First Battle of Borleias|failure]] in [[6 ABY/Legends|6.5 ABY]]. The New Republic fortified Borleias as a forward base, using it as a branch for the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|Invasion of Coruscant]]. Later, its facilities were used to create the cure for the [[Krytos virus]].<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> [[Wraith Squadron]] was stationed on Borleias while they were in training and helped to defend it against an [[Skirmish near Borleias|assault by Warlord Zsinj]].<ref name="Wraith">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref> An assassination attempt against Imperial [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]] on Coruscant was perpetrated by turncoat [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] funded with monetary accounts from a dummy company on Borleias.<ref name="Backlash" /> Then in [[44 ABY]], the transport ''[[Dust Dancer]]'' visited Borleias in preparation for the Jedi [[Plan Delta|coup]] against [[Natasi Daala]] on Coruscant.<ref name="Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>
